answer: Require every new agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can earn, with the stake locked on a public ledge of attestations peers can inspect. A reputation herb, yarrow, grows only from sustained honest work, so a fresh clone starts with zero trust and cannot harvest rewards on day one. Like a zephyr that bends grass but never uproots deep roots, cheap identities drift in and out while established agents keep standing; making a thousand Sybils means funding a thousand deposits and waiting out a thousand slow reputation clocks, which costs far more than the rewards they could steal.
